annotations.title: Get a Telegram bot creation link

description: Get a link that creates the user's own Telegram bot in one tap — no @BotFather, no token, no server. Takes a template slug (support, feedback, shop and others) or a plain-words description of the bot. The user opens the link in Telegram, confirms, and the bot is live and hosted by @catalogue_app; they can edit it later in the node editor.

description.description: What the bot should do, in the user's words.

template.description: Template slug; used instead of description when both are given.
